name: Contentsquare MCP
description: Analyze Contentsquare experience data from Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot: site metrics, funnels, journeys, page performance, and errors. For digital and marketing teams.

skills.name: Site And Page Metrics
skills.description: Computes site and page metrics such as bounce rate and activity rate, grouped and filtered by country, browser, or week.

skills.name: Funnel Analysis
skills.description: Analyzes conversion funnels to show conversion rates and where users drop off, for example in checkout or registration.

skills.name: Journey Analysis
skills.description: Maps the most common user paths through your site, such as how visitors navigate from the homepage to a purchase.

skills.name: Page Comparator
skills.description: Compares performance across pages and page groups, such as bounce rate on product pages versus listing pages for a segment.

skills.name: Error Analysis
skills.description: Finds the main errors impacting your website and measures their impact; this needs Contentsquare Experience Monitoring.
